rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for an ordinary household storage cabinet or cupboard.

example.english: This cabinet is big enough to hold all the bowls.
example.traditional: 呢個櫃夠大，可以擺晒啲碗。
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 gwai6 gau3 daai6 ho2 ji5 baai2 saai3 di1 wun2

rows.note: Use this for the group of government ministers responsible for executive policy.

example.english: The cabinet met today to discuss the new policy.
example.traditional: 內閣今日開會討論新政策。
example.jyutping: noi6 gok3 gam1 jat6 hoi1 wui2 tou2 leon6 san1 zing3 caak3

rows.note: Use this for a group of advisors serving a government or business.

example.english: The company formed a cabinet of advisers to study the market.
example.traditional: 公司成立咗一個顧問團，幫手研究市場。
example.jyutping: gung1 si1 sing4 lap6 zo2 jat1 go3 gu3 man6 tyun4 bong1 sau2 jin4 gau3 si5 coeng4

rows.note: Use this specifically for a cabinet or enclosure housing mechanical or electrical equipment.

example.english: The equipment is housed in a cabinet.
example.jyutping: bou6 gei1 baai2 zo2 hai2 gei1 gwai6 jap6 min6
